terms.gloss: look through, look closely at, examine; see clearly, ascertain
evidence: Caes. BG 7.44: operis perspiciendī causā venīre (Lewis & Short)
Caes. BG 5.5: quōrum in sē fidem perspexerat (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: eās ego oportet perspiciam, corrigam: tum dēnique ēdentur
phrases.english: I must look through them (the letters) and correct them; only then will they be published
